description:
This image displays a screenshot of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CLC+ Core User Administration interface, specifically the "Data Catalogue" view with an "Add Extraction" modal window open.

The main interface features a data table with the following columns: "EAGLE Approved" (checkbox), "Name", "Type", "Created At", "Created By", "Organisation/s", "Status", and "Resolution". Data entries include:
*   "ES616_10m" (Type: Folder, Created At: 25.09.2026, Status: DRAFT, Resolution: 10 m)
*   "Extraccion_es616_100m" (Type: Play icon, Created At: 18.09.2026, Status: EXTRACTED, Resolution: 100 m)
*   "ES616_100m" (Type: Folder, Created At: 18.09.2026, Status: USED, Resolution: 100 m)
*   "ES616_roads" (Type: Play icon, Created At: 01.09.2026, Status: EXTRACTED, Resolution: 100 m)
*   "ES616_100m" (Type: Folder, Created At: 01.09.2026, Status: INGESTED, Resolution: 100 m)
*   "EFFIS 2024 (10m test)" (Type: Folder, Created At: 25.08.2026, Status: USED, Resolution: 10 m)
*   "HRL - NVLCC - Imperviousness" (Type: Folder, Created At: 12.08.2026, Status: USED, Resolution: 10 m)
*   "Urban Atlas (UA) 2021 (10m)" (Type: Folder, Created At: 29.07.2026, Status: USED, Resolution: 10 m)
*   "Riparian Zones (RZ) 2018 (..." (Type: Folder, Created At: 29.07.2026, Status: USED, Resolution: 10 m)

The "Created By" column for the top five entries shows "CLC+ Core User Admin", while the bottom three show "Innerbichler F". The "Organisation/s" column typically shows "CLC, European Environment Agency (EEA)" or "European Environment Agency (EEA)".

A modal window titled "Add Extraction" is overlaid on the right side of the screen. It contains fields for defining a new extraction:
*   "Name*": pre-filled with "ES616_roads".
*   "Country*": pre-filled with "ES Spain/España".
*   "Region": pre-filled with "ES616 Jaén".
*   Resolution options: "100 meters" (unselected radio button) and "10 meters" (selected radio button).
Buttons "CANCEL" and "ADD" are at the bottom of the modal.

The top navigation bar includes "Data Catalogue", "EAGLE Ontology", "About EAGLE", "Organisations", and "Users". Action buttons on the main screen include "Filter", "My organisation/s", "My data", "Ingestions", "Extractions", "100 meters", "10 meters", "Search", "ADD INGESTION", and "ADD EXTRACTION".
